faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Find answers about the demo menu and Zestora.
faq.oneA: Open a product from the menu to see its ingredients and available options. Ask the shop directly if you have an allergy or dietary concern.
faq.twoA: You can browse the demo menu and preview choices. Checkout will become available when an ordering system and shop settings are connected.
faq.threeQ: How can I switch to Sinhala?
faq.threeA: Use the language control in the header. The site remembers your choice on this browser.
faq.fourA: The displayed prices are for the demo. A participating shop will set its own products, prices, and fulfilment options.

policy.notice: The business owner must publish the shop’s approved policy before accepting live orders.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.text: The storefront saves your language preference in this browser. If you choose to email a shop, your email service handles that message. The shop’s privacy policy will describe customer data handling when ordering is enabled.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.text: The demo shows example items and prices. Each shop can set its own terms for products, ordering, payment, delivery, and pickup.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.text: A shop’s approved refund policy will explain eligibility, how to make a request, and how the shop handles a refund after it is approved.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.text: A shop’s approved cancellation policy will explain when a customer can request a cancellation and how to contact the shop about an order.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: Check the address or return to the homepage.
